$comment: The profile-resolution comparison: the same requested profile or tag across host-manifest revisions, one row per (request, host, effective identity) — two hosts that legitimately map one tag to different stacks stay two rows, and nothing here may collapse different effective identities under a shared spelling. Input: { resolutions: [{ host, hostManifestRevision, request, identity }] } as the resolver produced them. Executed verbatim with compileJsonQuery.
